title: Greek-Style Salad with Feta
teaser: A fresh, no-cook option for a hot evening.
steps: Combine the cucumber, tomatoes, and onion in a large bowl.
Scatter the feta and olives over the top.
Whisk the olive oil and vinegar together and drizzle over the salad.
Toss gently and serve with warm pitta or bread.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
teaser: A heartier, main-course version of the classic side salad.
steps: Season the chicken and pan-fry or grill until cooked through, then slice.
Toss the lettuce with the caesar dressing in a large bowl.
Top with the sliced chicken, parmesan, and croutons.
Serve immediately while the croutons are still crisp.

title: Warm Potato & Bacon Salad
teaser: New potatoes and crispy bacon in a light mustard dressing, best served warm.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes, then drain.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Whisk the mustard, oil, and vinegar together.
Toss the warm potatoes with the bacon, spring onions, and dressing.

title: Salmon & New Potato Salad
teaser: Warm new potatoes, flaked salmon, and a light mustard dressing.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 12-15 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
Meanwhile, season the salmon and pan-fry or grill for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through. Flake into chunks.
Whisk the mustard, olive oil, and lemon juice together.
Toss the warm potatoes and beans with the dressing.
Top with the flaked salmon and serve.

title: Chicken Caesar Pasta Salad
teaser: A pasta twist on the classic Caesar, good served warm or chilled.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions, drain, and cool slightly.
Toss the pasta with the caesar dressing.
Fold in the lettuce, chicken, and parmesan.
Top with croutons just before serving.
